# Copilot instructions

The canonical, tool-neutral instructions for this repository live in
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Read that file first and follow it.

Start every task at [MAP.md](../MAP.md), route through [INDEX.md](../INDEX.md),
and never load `meetings/*-transcript.it.md` or `meetings/open-items*.md`
whole. Project knowledge is written to `notes/` as atomic notes; the documents
in `meetings/` are rendered views regenerated from them.
